You will join a stable and growing production company in Purmerend. The company invests in its people and offers opportunities to grow into roles with more responsibility. Teamwork, quality and safety are key here. 
As a 3-shift operator in Purmerend, you keep the production process running smoothly. You will earn a gross monthly salary of €3,600 to €4,320 including shift allowance, with the prospect of a permanent contract and plenty of opportunities to develop yourself. 
About the function 
As an operator, you keep the production lines running. You set up machines, change them over for product changes and check that products meet quality standards. You also register production data and closely monitor the process. 
Is there a minor technical issue? You investigate the cause and solve it yourself where possible. Together with your colleagues, you make sure the process runs safely and efficiently. You follow all quality, safety and hygiene guidelines. 
You work in a 3-shift schedule: 07:00 to 15:00, 15:00 to 23:00 and 23:00 to 07:00. This requires flexibility, but you receive an attractive shift allowance in return. 
What we offer - €3,600 to €4,320 gross per month, including 20% shift allowance - 12-month secondment contract with the prospect of a permanent contract - A stable employer with a future - Development and career growth opportunities - 24 holiday days and 18 TVT days - Work that is not physically demanding 
What we need - MBO level of work and thinking - Experience in a production environment or similar sector - Technical insight and problem-solving skills - Good command of Dutch or English - Willingness to work in a 3-shift schedule
